characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Bruker D8 DISCOVER, Cu Kα radiation
characterization_methods.key_findings: Only FCC single-phase peaks (γ(111), γ(200), γ(220), γ(311), γ(222)); no second-phase peaks.
Uniform distribution of all steel elements (Fe, Mn, Al, C); no pronounced segregation; single FCC phase supported.
characterization_methods.purpose: Compositional analysis and element distribution mapping

characterization_methods.key_findings: BF/DF TEM confirms nanoscale κ phase precipitates; SAED (zone axis Z=[011]) verifies κ superlattice spots; BF shows dislocation tangles.
Recrystallized equiaxed grains with average grain size 17 μm; phase map uniformly FCC with no BCC (green) regions.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Samples polished with SiC sandpaper to 3000 grit and electrochemically polished in HClO4:C2H5OH = 1:9 (volume ratio) at 25 V at room temperature.
characterization_methods.purpose: Grain orientation mapping and phase mapping

characterization_methods.key_findings: Equiaxed single-phase grains with numerous straight parallel annealing twins; no second phase or precipitate contrast visible.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: SHIMADZU AGS universal electronic tensile tester
characterization_methods.key_findings: Yield strength 953 MPa, tensile strength 1109 MPa, elongation 42 %.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Nominal strain rate 1 × 10^-3 s^-1, ambient temperature; dog-bone specimens with gauge 10 mm × 4 mm × 2 mm.

analytical_models.model_note: Used to screen density ≤ 7 g/cm³ (later maximum 6.9 g/cm³); no equation explicitly printed in the text.

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Composition Fe-30Mn-8Al-1C (30 wt% Mn, 8 wt% Al, 1 wt% C, balance Fe); screening conditions included κ phase exists, single γ region, (γ+κ) region at 500–600 °C, κ fraction ≥ 10%, density ≤ 7 g/cm³.
computational_details.potential_model_or_database: JMatPro v9.0 general steel database (phase balance data) combined with historical literature data
computational_details.simulation_method: machine learning (random forest classification + SVM regression) for phase-structure prediction
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Predicted characteristics showed excellent agreement with experimental results; the aged Fe-30Mn-8Al-1C steel was predicted to be single-phase austenitic with low density and high strength, matching the measured single FCC + κ microstructure and tensile properties.

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: During force deformation, κ-carbides are sheared by dislocations belonging to the {111}〈110〉 slip system, while dislocation bypassing can also occur.

interfaces.phase_evolution: κ phase generated at 550 °C during aging; confirmed as the (γ+κ) dual-phase at 500–600 °C.
interfaces.slip_behavior: {111}〈110〉 slip system; κ-carbides sheared by dislocations during deformation, with possible dislocation bypassing.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: low density relative to conventional steel; combines high strength with excellent ductility

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The steel was prepared by induction melting under an Ar atmosphere.
The as-cast 25 kg ingot was homogenized at 1200 °C for 2 h.
Forged into a cross-sectional billet of 60 mm × 60 mm.
After homogenization at 1050 °C for 100 min, the forging stock was hot-rolled.
Hot-rolled to 12 mm thick plates and air-cooled to room temperature.
Cold-rolled with a 75 % thickness reduction at room temperature.
The rolled plate was annealed at 1000 °C for 15 min to achieve a recrystallized microstructure.
Aged at 550 °C for 2 h (terminal heat-treatment state).

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: SHIMADZU AGS universal electronic tensile tester
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: dog-bone-shaped specimens; gauge dimensions 10 mm (length) × 4 mm (width) × 2 mm (thickness), prepared by electrical discharge machining

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress–strain curve shown in Fig. 9b for the condition 'Fe-30Mn-8Al-1C : 1000°C/15min-550°C/2h'.

precipitates.distribution: dense and fairly uniform dispersion; intragranular

structures.overall_structure: Recrystallized single-phase FCC austenite containing nanoscale intragranular κ-carbide precipitates; average grain size 17 μm.
